title: Make strict doctor and sync refresh concurrency safe for gates
description: Dogfooding anomaly: running bwrk sync refresh --json and bwrk doctor --strict --json concurrently can make doctor report stale ledger/cache/search/context projection warnings while sync is actively rebuilding and later succeeds. This creates noisy or misleading closeout/gate failures. Scope: either serialize generated-artifact refresh before doctor in gate workflows, or make doctor detect active refresh locks and return a clear retry/active-refresh state instead of stale projection diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate workflows that run generated-artifact refresh and strict doctor do not produce misleading stale ledger/cache/search/context warnings while a refresh is active.
Doctor either waits/serializes appropriately or returns an explicit active-refresh/retry state when refresh locks are present.
The expected behavior is covered by a deterministic regression test or by committed documentation/behavior contract if a deterministic concurrent test is not practical.
closedReason: verified concurrency gate behavior and recorded final summary
